app.name: Release Rail
app.description: A finite release sequence whose visible controls and WebMCP tools operate one revisioned path.

tools.name: inspect_release_rail
tools.title: Inspect release rail
tools.description: Read the ordered sample release steps, their durable states, the current step, completion count, and revision. Does not modify the rail.

preconditions: The Release Rail document is active.
successEvidence: The result contains every step, the current step, completion count, and revision.

tools.name: advance_release_step
tools.title: Advance release step
tools.description: Complete the current release step and move the sample rail to its next pending step when the supplied revision is current.

expectedRevision.description: Rail revision observed immediately before advancing.

preconditions: The Release Rail document is active.
expectedRevision matches the current rail revision.
semantics.visibleEffect: The current node completes and the next pending node becomes current.
successEvidence: The result names the completed step and next current step.
The visible path and revision match the result.
failureModes: The rail revision changed before commit.

tools.name: reopen_release_step
tools.title: Reopen release step
tools.description: Make one completed step current and return every later step to pending when the supplied revision is current.

stepId.description: Identifier of the completed step to reopen.

expectedRevision.description: Rail revision observed immediately before reopening.

preconditions: The named step exists and is complete.
expectedRevision matches the current rail revision.
semantics.visibleEffect: The named step becomes current and every later step becomes pending.
successEvidence: The result names the reopened and affected steps.
The visible path and revision match the result.
failureModes: The step does not exist or is not complete.
The rail revision changed before commit.
